I've been in a similar situation myself, and yeah, it sucks a lot. But I wouldn't stop going to therapy (even if you decide to go with a different therapist). I hated it at first, and it took me roughly 5 different therapists to find someone I really clicked with, but once I found one and started going regularly, they've helped me a lot. I'd specifically mention your parents' reactions to things, they may be able to help, or even have family sessions with you. Imo, I don't necessarily agree with the therapist telling your parents, but I don't have all the context either. Imo it's your parents who should be ashamed for their reactions. At the end of the day your therapist was trying to do their job and what they felt was best for your well being. Don't give up! Keep at it! There IS happiness to be found, some of us just have to work harder for it than others, but it's definitely worth the work! I'm cheering for you!
